summary: community.proxmox will change the proxmox certificate verification default from false to true in version 2.0.0.
questions: Will community.proxmox verify TLS certificates by default?

answer_card.title: proxmox certificate verification default changes
answer_card.answer_md: In community.proxmox **2.0.0**, the `proxmox` module's certificate verification default changes from `false` to **`true`**. Set it explicitly or configure `ca_path` to prepare.
